title: Tip from Angela - Habit Building with the Calendar Trick
summary: Study-habit tip: code a little every day and mark each day on a calendar so the growing streak keeps you going until coding becomes routine.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Steady daily practice (for example an hour a day over 100 days) beats occasional bursts such as one weekend and then nothing.
The goal is a habit: once practice is automatic you stop deciding each day whether to do it.
Calendar method (the 'don't break the chain' idea credited to Jerry Seinfeld): cross off every day you code. The unbroken line becomes its own motivation not to skip a day.
After roughly 30-40 days the routine tends to stick and needs much less willpower.
Above all, keep showing up; consistent work produces results.

gaps_and_ideas: Optional: a small streak tracker on the playground home page (days with a completed lesson shown as a chain), stored per learner, to support the calendar method.
